notes.title: The Cost Of Bliss 1.0.5 Dificulty and Checkpoints
notes.notes:
Small patch to add a few simple features, here's the list:

- Levels now have checkpoints
- Sound behaviour reworked to avoid detection through walls
- Detection reworked to give players a more forgiving experience

Enjoy!
